title: Table
description:
A table shows the rows as they are: every column (or `column_list`), one row per result
row, long cells wrapping inside their column. See `:help dbdash-chart-types` and
`:help dbdash-css`.

args.name: team
args.description: Shown in the first panel's query

query.sql:
SELECT datetime('now', 'localtime') AS current_time,
       abs(random() % 100) AS load,
       abs(random() % 1000) AS sales,
       CASE abs(random() % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'Active' WHEN 1 THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS status,
       {{ args.team | sql_quote }} AS team

show.title: column_list: alias, width, thresholds
show.description:
`column_list` picks the columns in order: `alias` renames the header, `width` fixes
the width, `thresholds` color a column's cells by value (>= 50 yellow, >= 90 red).
The query reads the argument `team` (shown above the table by `args_show`).

query.sql:
SELECT 'disk ' || n AS volume, abs(random() % 100) AS free_pct
FROM (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4)

show.title: thresholds_below: lower is worse
show.description:
`thresholds_below: true` turns the steps around: a value at or below a step gets
its color (free space under 30% yellow, under 10% red).

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 9)
SELECT 'job-' || i AS job, abs(random() % 500) AS ms FROM n

show.title: sort, max_rows_shown
show.description:
`sort` orders the rows here, whatever the query did (DataTables `order`):
`{ column, order: asc | desc }`, NULLs last. `max_rows_shown` shows the first N
and says how many more there are.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Widgets' AS product, 1234567.891 AS revenue, 0.1834 AS margin
UNION ALL SELECT 'Gadgets', 98765.4, 0.0712
UNION ALL SELECT 'Gizmos', 4321.0, -0.021

show.title: column_list: format, style, align

query.sql:
SELECT 'api' AS service, 12 AS errors UNION ALL SELECT 'web', 0
UNION ALL SELECT 'worker', 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'cron', 41

show.title: row_thresholds: color whole rows
show.description:
`row_thresholds` colors every cell of a row by one column's value (AG Grid
`rowStyle`): rows with 1+ errors yellow, 10+ red. `below: true` turns it around.

query.sql:
SELECT 'alpha' AS name, 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 'beta', NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'gamma', 3
UNION ALL SELECT 'delta', NULL

show.title: compact and striped, null_text
show.description:
Bootstrap `.table-sm` (`cell_padding: 0`) and `.table-striped` (`striped`: the
background of every other row), the header and border colors, and how NULL looks
(`null_text`, `null_style`).

query.sql: SELECT 1 AS id, 'single' AS line UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'between the rows'

show.title: border: heavy, show_lines, caption: bottom
show.description:
One line style for the whole table (`border`: single, rounded, heavy, double,
dashed, ascii; `false` / `none` for none; the default mixes a heavy header with a
light body), lines between the rows (`show_lines`), and the title under the table
(`caption: bottom`, CSS `caption-side`).

query.sql:
SELECT 'Long text wraps inside its column; a word longer than the column is cut.' AS note,
       'first line' || char(10) || 'second line' AS lines

show.title: wrap, cell_width, cell_height, column height
show.description:
Long cells wrap at spaces (`wrap: true`, the default; `"char"` breaks anywhere,
`false` keeps one line cut with "…"), newlines in a value start a new line.
`cell_width` / `cell_height` limit every column, `column_list[].width` / `height`
one column; a cell still too long ends with "…".

query.sql: SELECT 'no border' AS plain, 'no lines at all' AS columns

show.title: border: false
show.description: No border: plain columns under a rule (Bootstrap `.table-borderless`).
